column2: Yesterday saw the climactic battle between the forces of Christendom, for once seemingly united under the Clintons' banner, and the army of the Mahonics at the Battle of Saratoga Springs. Now, the Yankee king is dead, his army broken and treasury empty. It seems Hudsonia is entering its best days. Further South, the streets of Manhattan whisper of a coming revolution against the entrenched power of House Skulski, and it appears another Americanist-Anabaptist war is brewing...

The young queen Tiaogeara Clinton has thus far had a remarkably successful reign. Unexpectedly raised to the throne as a girl of ten, many had guessed she would join her father and brother in heaven all too soon. Tiaogeara has proven them wrong. Confronted with the existential threat of Zadok Mahonic, Tiaogeara deftly formed a pan-Christian alliance to strike down the vile Yankee horde. Reconciling her forebears' feud with the St Louis Pope, Tiaogeara was crowned by the Pontiff himself before her gathered forces. Now she is victorious, and beloved by New Rome. It seems Hudsonia's maiden queen can do little wrong...

Lucky to escape the Battle of Saratoga with his life, Sidrach Mahonic has inherited a national catastrophe from his brother, King Zadok. Not only is the army battered, his brother dead and the treasury bare, there is also trouble in New Brunswick. Sidrach has a long and dark road ahead if he seeks to save his Kingdom.
